# Cris Santos Company | Utilities | Multi-Sector

> Cris Santos Company Holdings, Inc. is a publicly traded, diversified enterprise with 45,000 employees. Its Utilities division, the focus of this scenario, operates as an electric distribution utility serving residential and commercial customers. The company also runs divisions in NAICS 21 Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction and NAICS 54 Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services.

This folder is a self-contained scenario. Read this page first, then open any project folder (P01-P10). Each project folder has a `_context.md` explaining what that deliverable looks like for this company.

## What the business handles
- **Sensitive data:** CEII - Critical Energy/Electric Infrastructure Information (18 CFR 388.113); BES Cyber System Information (CIP-011); Safeguards Information (10 CFR 73.21-73.22); SSI (49 CFR Part 1520) for TSA-regulated pipelines; Water RRA/ERP content; Customer PII, usage/smart-meter data and payment card data
- **Critical systems:** SCADA/EMS; DCS in generating plants; Distribution management systems (ADMS/OMS); AMI/smart meters; Protective relays and substation automation (IEC 61850); Water treatment PLC/HMI; Customer information and billing systems

## Who regulates it
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC); North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) - ERO; Department of Energy (DOE CESER) - Energy SRMA; Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC); Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Water SRMA; Transportation Security Administration (TSA) - gas pipelines/LNG

| Requirement | Citation | Size thresholds / exemptions |
|---|---|---|
| [NERC CIP Reliability Standards (CIP-002 through CIP-014; CIP-015 approved)](https://www.nerc.com/standards/reliability-standards/cip) | Federal Power Act sec. 215 (16 U.S.C. 824o); 18 CFR Part 40; NERC CIP-002-5.1a, CIP-003-9, CIP-004 to CIP-014 (current enforceable versions) | Impact rating via CIP-002 Attachment 1 bright-line criteria, e.g., medium impact for generation with net Real Power capability >= 1,500 MW in a single Interconnection; high impact for control centers of BA/GOP/TOP controlling >= 3,000 MW; UFLS/UVLS programs of 300 MW or more bring Distribution Providers into scope. Low-impact assets have reduced (CIP-003) requirements. |
| [TSA Security Directive Pipeline-2021-02G (Pipeline Cybersecurity Mitigation Actions, Contingency Planning, and Testing)](https://www.tsa.gov/sites/default/files/signed_security_directive_pipeline-2021-02g_and_transmittal_memo_508c.pdf) | TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G, issued under 49 U.S.C. 114 | No numeric threshold; applies to TSA-notified critical pipeline systems/facilities. |
| [NRC power reactor cyber security rule](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-10/section-73.54) | 10 CFR 73.54 | None. |
| [SDWA sec. 1433 Risk & Resilience Assessment / ERP (AWIA 2018 sec. 2013)](https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?req=granuleid:USC-prelim-title42-section300i-2&num=0&edition=prelim) | 42 U.S.C. 300i-2 | > 3,300 population served; tiered deadlines at 100,000+ and 50,000-99,999. |

Whether each requirement applies at this size is decided in P03 (gap analysis), step 1.

## The 10 projects for this company
| # | Project | What it covers here |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | [Risk Register](P01_risk-register/_context.md) | Group and division registers. Division registers roll up to group ERM. |
| P02 | [System Security Plan (SSP)](P02_system-security-plan/_context.md) | One system per division or a shared corporate system. SSP with common controls inherited from corporate. System: Distribution SCADA and outage management system. |
| P03 | [Regulatory Gap Analysis](P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/_context.md) | Each division's primary regulation plus group-wide obligations. Regulation-by-division matrix. Regulation: NERC CIP Reliability Standards. |
| P04 | [Control-to-Cloud Architecture Mapping](P04_cloud-control-mapping/_context.md) | Shared corporate cloud platform plus division workloads. Common vs division-specific controls. |
| P05 | [Business Impact Analysis (BIA)](P05_business-impact-analysis/_context.md) | Group and division BIAs. Cross-division dependencies and shared services. |
| P06 | [Security Policy Set](P06_security-policies/_context.md) | Group policies with division supplements. Group policy plus division-specific standards. |
| P07 | [Security Control Assessment](P07_control-assessment/_context.md) | Common controls plus division samples. Assess common controls once; sample division controls. |
| P08 | [Incident Response Runbook](P08_incident-response-runbook/_context.md) | Incident spanning divisions. Notification matrix across all division regulators. Incident: Intrusion into distribution control systems (OT). |
| P09 | [SOC 2 Readiness Checklist](P09_soc2-readiness/_context.md) | Service lines per division. Scoping decisions per division. |
| P10 | [AI Governance Risk Assessment](P10_ai-governance/_context.md) | Group AI governance program. Group standards; division use cases; regulator-specific rules. AI use case: Electric load-forecasting model. |
